title: Dentistry With Heart returns set for Friday - NewsBreak
text: MOUNT AIRY — Area residents, as well as those in surrounding regions, in need of dental care without the means to afford it have a chance to address some of those needs on Friday. Dr. John L. Gravitte will host his annual charitable event, a day of free dentistry, providing adults in need with dental care on that day at his practice at 140 North Pointe Blvd. Dr. Gravitte began the annual event in 2014. “We began this event in our new facility that allows us to provide free care for many more patients. Being born and raised in Mount Airy, my dedication to our community has never been stronger and this event is one way both me and my team can give back to those in need,” Dr. Gravitte said. Dental professionals from across the state, along with members of the community, volunteer their time and expertise, joining the team at Dr. Gravitte and Associates to provide care to as many patients as possible. Patients receive a dental exam and their choice of a filling, extraction or preventative hygiene cleaning. As in previous years, each patient seen will also receive OralID, an advanced oral cancer screening. “We are very excited to bring this much-anticipated event to our community,” said event coordinator and marketing director for the practice, Amanda Fretwell. “The success of the event is attributed to the commitment of the many volunteers. Our student internship programs have grown through our partnerships with local schools, and this event provides an important and rewarding experience for those students to volunteer and see first-hand how rewarding a career in dentistry truly is! In years past, we’ve been able to help hundreds of people in need. Every year our goal is to help more patients, and we anticipate this year to be our best yet.” Adult patients are asked to arrive early as the event is organized on a first-come, first-served basis. Event registration will begin at 7:30 a.m.
